capabilities: Update links automatically on cut and paste of headings and blocks
Repair broken links in a file via a command
Search the metadata cache to locate moved headings and blocks
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not about permanent or published URLs; it repairs internal wiki links after headings and blocks move.
extras: README warns the plugin relies on internal Obsidian APIs and may break; it only auto-updates on cut and paste and only supports wiki links.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically update internal links when headings or blocks are cut and pasted into other files, so links break silently.
summary: Link-maintenance plugin that automatically repairs internal wiki links to headings and blocks when they are moved between files.
